verdictScope: Bounded report acceptance with the qualifications below, not wholesale adoption of every report sentence, whole-set certification or publication approval.

F1.decision: accepted (medium) as a direct-pair displayed-label consistency guard, not lexical identity
F1.basis: 耗 displays 'decrease; wear down through use' and its own body says 摩耗 illustrates wear through friction (snapshot/kanji/耗.md:3,26-27). Daijisen glosses 耗 すりへる and lists 摩耗 (04-extract.txt:11); JMdict 1604200 摩耗/磨耗 is 'wear; abrasion' (jmdict-families.xml:243). 擦's own reading row glosses 擦れる 'to rub; to chafe; to wear out' (repo/kanji/擦.md:33) and 摩 displays 'rub; chafe' (repo/kanji/摩.md:3). Neither endpoint declares either pair (耗.md:14; 擦.md:14 [磨, 掃]; 摩.md:14 [擦, 磨, 研]). Exclusions are symmetric when declared on either card (repo/docs/content-format.md:103). The candidate's own threshold already guards 殺 on its KANJIDIC2 'diminish; reduce' glosses alone (kanjidic2-records.xml:124), a weaker overlap.
F1.required: Declare the direct 耗/擦 and 耗/摩 pairs, preferably on 耗 so earlier cards stay unchanged, and add a concise qualified 耗 Notes explanation (friction/wear overlap, not synonymy). Preserve all existing 耗 guards, metadata, selected readings, curated choices and geometry; rerun validation, manifest rebuild and applicable gates.
F1.qualification: 摩 and 擦 are rubbing/friction actions, not depletion; the overlap is through the wear-by-friction labels. This does not establish transitive guards (e.g. via 摩/磨/研) or universal synonymy. D14 磨 remains a reviewed harmless disposition: its displayed label is 'polish; grind' and its rub/chafe row is a rare 擦る-family spelling (repo/kanji/磨.md:3,20,32); the 磨耗 JMdict variant spelling alone does not make 磨 required.
F1.exposureQualification: The report correctly notes current N1/All/Starter curated choices fill every slot. The contract nevertheless requires direct symmetric meaning exclusions; fallback, custom and smaller pools remain untested.

F2.decision: accepted (low) as a consistency finding with two permitted remedies
F2.basis: 削 displays 'shave; sharpen; pare'; its card says 削る can mean reducing an amount, glosses けず.る 'cut down', lists 削減 'reduction; cut' and 予算を削る 'cut the budget' (repo/kanji/削.md:3,22,31,41,44). 耗 displays 'decrease' first. Neither card declares the pair (削 has no quiz_exclusions; 耗.md:14), while 耗 guards 減 and 殺 for decrease/diminish overlaps.
F2.required: Either declare the direct 耗/削 pair with a concise Notes mention, or record in 耗's Notes a sourced reason why 削's transitive cut/pare reduction sense is not an ordinary meaning-choice collision with 'decrease; wear down through use'.
F2.qualification: 削 is a transitive cutting/paring action; 耗 is decrease or wear through use. The overlap is the reduce/cut-down region only, not identity.

optionalPoints.basis: The cached Joyo row and both Daijisen character extracts list only ヘイ, placing 石塀/板塀/土塀 under it (joyo-rows.json:9; 01-extract.txt:12-14; 06-extract.txt:5-7). Both 辺 and 際 are precautionary edge labels; neither means a wall. Threshold wording is polish, not a demonstrated defect.
The 83 nonfatal exclusion-not-mentioned warnings were already disclosed (quiz-safety.txt). Unexplained precautionary guards are not shown to be wrong; grouping rationale is optional.
